snippet.title: Still Breathing - a Narrative survival horror where you have to keep your family alive.
snippet.description:
The world ended. Your family didn't.

STILL BREATHING is a narrative survival game about keeping a family of five — and a dog — alive in a bunker after the collapse. Ration what's left. Send someone out to scavenge what the world hasn't taken yet. Decide who you let in when a stranger knocks at the door — and what you take from them in return.

There are no fair choices. Only the ones you can live with.

▸ One family, one bunker, every member with their own arc and breaking point
▸ Knocks at the door at night — help them, turn them away, or do something worse
▸ First-person exploration of an abandoned, contaminated world
▸ Manage food, water, electricity, heating, medicine, morale
▸ Combat with real weight — every kill is a choice, every mercy a risk
▸ Multiple endings. None of them clean.

KEEP CALM. STAY QUIET. STAY ALIVE.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4594740/Still_Breathing/
💬 Join the Discord → https://discord.gg/JSFcMpbgyw

A Dad and Son Games production · directed by Victor Vergara · story by Alex Vergara
